`src/dxvk.rs`:

```rs
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

pub const MARKER_NAME: &str = ".dxvk_by_gad.txt";
pub const CANDIDATES: [&str; 5] = ["d3d8.dll", "d3d9.dll", "d3d10core.dll", "d3d11.dll", "dxgi.dll"];

pub fn is_dxvk_file(path: &str) -> bool {
    if path.is_empty() || !Path::new(path).is_file() {
        return false;
    }
    match crate::util::file_version_strings(path) {
        Some((_, company, product)) => {
            company.to_lowercase().contains("dxvk") || product.to_lowercase().contains("dxvk")
        }
        None => false,
    }
}

pub fn installed_files(game_dir: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    if game_dir.is_empty() {
        return result;
    }
    for name in CANDIDATES {
        let path = Path::new(game_dir).join(name);
        if is_dxvk_file(&path.to_string_lossy()) {
            result.push(name.to_string());
        }
    }
    result
}

pub fn probe(exe_path: &str) -> String {
    let dir = safe_dir(exe_path);
    if dir.is_empty() {
        return String::new();
    }
    let files = installed_files(&dir);
    if files.is_empty() {
        return String::new();
    }
    format!("DXVK（{}）", files.join(" + "))
}

pub fn is_installed(exe_path: &str) -> bool {
    !probe(exe_path).is_empty()
}

pub fn safe_dir(exe_path: &str) -> String {
    if exe_path.is_empty() {
        return String::new();
    }
    match Path::new(exe_path).parent() {
        Some(p) => p.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
        None => String::new(),
    }
}

fn marker_path(game_dir: &str) -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(game_dir).join(MARKER_NAME)
}

fn read_marker(game_dir: &str) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {
    let mut records = BTreeMap::new();
    if let Ok(text) = fs::read_to_string(marker_path(game_dir)) {
        for line in text.lines() {
            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split('|').collect();
            if parts.len() == 2 && !parts[0].is_empty() {
                records.insert(parts[0].to_lowercase(), parts[1].to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    records
}

fn write_marker(game_dir: &str, records: &BTreeMap<String, String>) {
    let mut text = String::new();
    for (key, value) in records {
        text.push_str(key);
        text.push('|');
        text.push_str(value);
        text.push_str("\r\n");
    }
    let _ = fs::write(marker_path(game_dir), text);
}

pub fn restore(game_dir: &str) -> (usize, Vec<String>) {
    let mut errors = Vec::new();
    if game_dir.is_empty() || !Path::new(game_dir).is_dir() {
        return (0, errors);
    }
    let records = read_marker(game_dir);
    let mut restored = 0usize;

    for (name, _) in &records {
        let dst = Path::new(game_dir).join(name);
        let bak = Path::new(game_dir).join(format!("{}.dxvk_bak", name));
        let dst_s = dst.to_string_lossy().to_string();
        if bak.is_file() {
            if dst.is_file() {
                let _ = fs::remove_file(&dst);
            }
            match fs::rename(&bak, &dst) {
                Ok(_) => restored += 1,
                Err(e) => errors.push(format!("{}：{}", name, e)),
            }
        } else if dst.is_file() && is_dxvk_file(&dst_s) {
            match fs::remove_file(&dst) {
                Ok(_) => restored += 1,
                Err(e) => errors.push(format!("{}：{}", name, e)),
            }
        }
    }

    for name in CANDIDATES {
        if records.contains_key(&name.to_lowercase()) {
            continue;
        }
        let dst = Path::new(game_dir).join(name);
        let bak = Path::new(game_dir).join(format!("{}.dxvk_bak", name));
        if !is_dxvk_file(&dst.to_string_lossy()) {
            continue;
        }
        if bak.is_file() {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(&dst);
            match fs::rename(&bak, &dst) {
                Ok(_) => restored += 1,
                Err(e) => errors.push(format!("{}：{}", name, e)),
            }
        } else {
            match fs::remove_file(&dst) {
                Ok(_) => restored += 1,
                Err(e) => errors.push(format!("{}：{}", name, e)),
            }
        }
    }

    let _ = fs::remove_file(marker_path(game_dir));
    (restored, errors)
}

pub fn install(game_dir: &str, src_dir: &str, files: &[String]) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<String>) {
    let mut installed = Vec::new();
    let mut errors = Vec::new();
    let mut records = read_marker(game_dir);

    for file in files {
        let src = Path::new(src_dir).join(file);
        let dst = Path::new(game_dir).join(file);
        let bak = Path::new(game_dir).join(format!("{}.dxvk_bak", file));
        if !src.is_file() {
            errors.push(format!("{}：源文件不存在", file));
            continue;
        }
        let mut had_backup = bak.is_file();
        if dst.is_file() && !had_backup {
            if let Err(e) = fs::rename(&dst, &bak) {
                errors.push(format!("{}：{}", file, e));
                continue;
            }
            had_backup = true;
        }
        match fs::copy(&src, &dst) {
            Ok(_) => {
                installed.push(file.clone());
                records.insert(
                    file.to_lowercase(),
                    if had_backup { "1".to_string() } else { "0".to_string() },
                );
            }
            Err(e) => errors.push(format!("{}：{}", file, e)),
        }
    }

    write_marker(game_dir, &records);
    (installed, errors)
}

```

`src/library.rs`:

```rs
use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use winreg::enums::*;
use winreg::RegKey;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct GameInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub platform: String,
    pub root: String,
    pub exe_path: String,
}

pub fn ensure_dir(path: &str) -> String {
    let mut value = path.trim().trim_matches('"').replace('/', "\\");
    if value.is_empty() {
        return String::new();
    }
    while value.len() > 3 && value.ends_with('\\') {
        value.pop();
    }
    if !value.ends_with('\\') {
        value.push('\\');
    }
    value
}

fn dir_of(path: &str) -> String {
    match Path::new(path).parent() {
        Some(p) => ensure_dir(&p.to_string_lossy()),
        None => String::new(),
    }
}

fn first_match(text: &str, pattern: &str) -> String {
    match regex::Regex::new(pattern) {
        Ok(re) => re
            .captures(text)
            .and_then(|c| c.get(1))
            .map(|m| m.as_str().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default(),
        Err(_) => String::new(),
    }
}

fn unescape_vdf(value: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(value.len());
    let chars: Vec<char> = value.chars().collect();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < chars.len() {
        if chars[i] == '\\' && i + 1 < chars.len() && (chars[i + 1] == '\\' || chars[i + 1] == '"') {
            out.push(chars[i + 1]);
            i += 2;
        } else {
            out.push(chars[i]);
            i += 1;
        }
    }
    out
}

fn unescape_json(value: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(value.len());
    let chars: Vec<char> = value.chars().collect();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < chars.len() {
        if chars[i] != '\\' || i + 1 >= chars.len() {
            out.push(chars[i]);
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        let next = chars[i + 1];
        i += 2;
        match next {
            'n' => out.push('\n'),
            'r' => out.push('\r'),
            't' => out.push('\t'),
            'u' => {
                if i + 3 < chars.len() {
                    let hex: String = chars[i..i + 4].iter().collect();
                    if let Ok(code) = u32::from_str_radix(&hex, 16) {
                        if let Some(c) = char::from_u32(code) {
                            out.push(c);
                        }
                    }
                    i += 4;
                }
            }
            other => out.push(other),
        }
    }
    out
}

fn reg_string(key: &RegKey, name: &str) -> String {
    key.get_value::<String, _>(name).unwrap_or_default().trim().to_string()
}

fn sub_keys(key: &RegKey) -> Vec<String> {
    key.enum_keys().filter_map(|k| k.ok()).collect()
}

fn is_guid_like(value: &str) -> bool {
    if value.len() < 32 {
        return false;
    }
    value
        .chars()
        .all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit() || c == '-' || c == '{' || c == '}')
}

fn file_description(exe: &str) -> String {
    match crate::util::file_version_strings(exe) {
        Some(info) => {
            if !info.0.trim().is_empty() {
                return info.0.trim().to_string();
            }
            Path::new(exe)
                .file_stem()
                .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| exe.to_string())
        }
        None => Path::new(exe)
            .file_stem()
            .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| exe.to_string()),
    }
}

fn non_game_exe(stem: &str) -> bool {
    const LIST: [&str; 22] = [
        "java", "javaw", "python", "pythonw", "node", "chrome", "msedge", "firefox", "iexplore",
        "explorer", "notepad", "cmd", "powershell", "code", "devenv", "spotify", "vlc", "obs64",
        "discord", "werfault", "rundll32", "msiexec",
    ];
    LIST.contains(&stem)
}

fn open_hklm(path: &str, wow64: bool) -> Option<RegKey> {
    let flags = if wow64 {
        KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_64KEY
    } else {
        KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_32KEY
    };
    RegKey::predef(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE).open_subkey_with_flags(path, flags).ok()
}

fn make_game(name: &str, platform: &str, root_path: &str, exe_path: &str) -> Option<GameInfo> {
    let root = ensure_dir(root_path);
    if root.is_empty() || !Path::new(&root).is_dir() {
        return None;
    }
    let trimmed = name.trim();
    let final_name = if trimmed.is_empty() {
        let stripped = root.trim_end_matches('\\');
        Path::new(stripped)
            .file_name()
            .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    } else {
        trimmed.to_string()
    };
    Some(GameInfo {
        name: final_name,
        platform: platform.to_string(),
        root,
        exe_path: exe_path.to_string(),
    })
}

fn load_registry_roots(
    list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>,
    wow64: bool,
    sub_path: &str,
    platform: &str,
    dir_value: &str,
    name_value: &str,
) {
    let key = match open_hklm(sub_path, wow64) {
        Some(k) => k,
        None => return,
    };
    for sub_name in sub_keys(&key) {
        let sub = match key.open_subkey(&sub_name) {
            Ok(k) => k,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        let dir = reg_string(&sub, dir_value);
        if dir.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut game_name = if name_value.is_empty() {
            String::new()
        } else {
            reg_string(&sub, name_value)
        };
        if game_name.is_empty() && !is_guid_like(&sub_name) {
            game_name = sub_name.clone();
        }
        if let Some(game) = make_game(&game_name, platform, &dir, "") {
            list.push(game);
        }
    }
}

fn load_steam(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>) {
    let hkcu = RegKey::predef(HKEY_CURRENT_USER);
    let mut steam_path = String::new();
    if let Ok(key) = hkcu.open_subkey("Software\\Valve\\Steam") {
        steam_path = reg_string(&key, "SteamPath");
    }
    if steam_path.is_empty() {
        if let Ok(key) = hkcu.open_subkey("Software\\Wow6432Node\\Valve\\Steam") {
            steam_path = reg_string(&key, "SteamPath");
        }
    }
    if steam_path.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let steam_path = ensure_dir(&steam_path);
    if steam_path.is_empty() {
        return;
    }

    let mut libraries: Vec<String> = vec![steam_path.clone()];
    let vdf = Path::new(&steam_path).join("steamapps").join("libraryfolders.vdf");
    if let Ok(text) = fs::read_to_string(&vdf) {
        if let Ok(re) = regex::Regex::new(r#""path"\s*"([^"]*)""#) {
            for cap in re.captures_iter(&text) {
                let lib = ensure_dir(&unescape_vdf(&cap[1]));
                if lib.is_empty() {
                    continue;
                }
                if !libraries.iter().any(|x| x.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&lib)) {
                    libraries.push(lib);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for library in libraries {
        load_steam_library(list, &library);
    }
}

fn load_steam_library(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>, library: &str) {
    let steam_apps = Path::new(library).join("steamapps");
    if !steam_apps.is_dir() {
        return;
    }
    let common = steam_apps.join("common");
    let entries = match fs::read_dir(&steam_apps) {
        Ok(e) => e,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    for entry in entries.flatten() {
        let path = entry.path();
        let file_name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
        if !file_name.starts_with("appmanifest_") || !file_name.ends_with(".acf") {
            continue;
        }
        let text = match fs::read_to_string(&path) {
            Ok(t) => t,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        let name = unescape_vdf(&first_match(&text, r#""name"\s*"([^"]*)""#));
        let install_dir = unescape_vdf(&first_match(&text, r#""installdir"\s*"([^"]*)""#));
        if install_dir.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let root = ensure_dir(&common.join(&install_dir).to_string_lossy());
        if root.is_empty() || !Path::new(&root).is_dir() {
            continue;
        }
        list.push(GameInfo {
            name: if name.is_empty() { install_dir } else { name },
            platform: "Steam".to_string(),
            root,
            exe_path: String::new(),
        });
    }
}

fn load_epic(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>) {
    let program_data = std::env::var("ProgramData").unwrap_or_else(|_| "C:\\ProgramData".to_string());
    let dir = Path::new(&program_data)
        .join("Epic")
        .join("EpicGamesLauncher")
        .join("Data")
        .join("Manifests");
    let entries = match fs::read_dir(&dir) {
        Ok(e) => e,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    for entry in entries.flatten() {
        let path = entry.path();
        if path.extension().map(|e| e.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase()) != Some("item".to_string()) {
            continue;
        }
        let text = match fs::read_to_string(&path) {
            Ok(t) => t,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        let pattern: &str = r#""%s"\s*:\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)""#;
        let name = unescape_json(&first_match(&text, &pattern.replace("%s", "DisplayName")));
        let install_location =
            unescape_json(&first_match(&text, &pattern.replace("%s", "InstallLocation")));
        let launch_exe =
            unescape_json(&first_match(&text, &pattern.replace("%s", "LaunchExecutable")));
        if install_location.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let root = ensure_dir(&install_location);
        if root.is_empty() || !Path::new(&root).is_dir() {
            continue;
        }
        let fallback = install_location
            .trim_end_matches('\\')
            .rsplit('\\')
            .next()
            .unwrap_or("")
            .to_string();
        list.push(GameInfo {
            name: if name.is_empty() { fallback } else { name },
            platform: "Epic".to_string(),
            exe_path: if launch_exe.is_empty() {
                String::new()
            } else {
                Path::new(&root).join(&launch_exe).to_string_lossy().to_string()
            },
            root,
        });
    }
}

fn load_gog(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>) {
    let key = match open_hklm("SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\GOG.com\\Games", true) {
        Some(k) => k,
        None => match open_hklm("SOFTWARE\\GOG.com\\Games", false) {
            Some(k) => k,
            None => return,
        },
    };
    for sub_name in sub_keys(&key) {
        let sub = match key.open_subkey(&sub_name) {
            Ok(k) => k,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        let game_name = reg_string(&sub, "gameName");
        let path = reg_string(&sub, "path");
        let exe = reg_string(&sub, "exe");
        if path.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let root = ensure_dir(&path);
        if root.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let exe_path = if exe.is_empty() {
            String::new()
        } else if exe.len() > 1 && exe.as_bytes()[1] == b':' {
            exe.clone()
        } else {
            Path::new(&root)
                .join(exe.trim_start_matches('\\'))
                .to_string_lossy()
                .to_string()
        };
        list.push(GameInfo {
            name: if game_name.is_empty() { sub_name } else { game_name },
            platform: "GOG".to_string(),
            root,
            exe_path,
        });
    }
}

fn load_windows_games(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>) {
    let hkcu = RegKey::predef(HKEY_CURRENT_USER);
    let children = match hkcu.open_subkey("System\\GameConfigStore\\Children") {
        Ok(k) => k,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    for sub_name in sub_keys(&children) {
        let sub = match children.open_subkey(&sub_name) {
            Ok(k) => k,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        let exe_path = reg_string(&sub, "MatchedExeFullPath").replace('/', "\\");
        if exe_path.is_empty() || !Path::new(&exe_path).is_file() {
            continue;
        }
        let stem = Path::new(&exe_path)
            .file_stem()
            .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        if non_game_exe(&stem) {
            continue;
        }
        let root = dir_of(&exe_path);
        if root.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        list.push(GameInfo {
            name: file_description(&exe_path),
            platform: "Windows".to_string(),
            root,
            exe_path,
        });
    }
}

fn load_sub_folders(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>, root: &Path, platform: &str) {
    let entries = match fs::read_dir(root) {
        Ok(e) => e,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    for entry in entries.flatten() {
        if !entry.path().is_dir() {
            continue;
        }
        let leaf = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
        if leaf.is_empty() || leaf.eq_ignore_ascii_case("Content") {
            continue;
        }
        let folder = entry.path();
        let content = folder.join("Content");
        let target = if content.is_dir() { content } else { folder };
        if let Some(game) = make_game(&leaf, platform, &target.to_string_lossy(), "") {
            list.push(game);
        }
    }
}

fn load_xbox_uninstall(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>, wow64: bool) {
    let key = match open_hklm(
        "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall",
        wow64,
    ) {
        Some(k) => k,
        None => return,
    };
    for sub_name in sub_keys(&key) {
        let sub = match key.open_subkey(&sub_name) {
            Ok(k) => k,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        let location = reg_string(&sub, "InstallLocation");
        if location.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let lower = location.to_lowercase();
        if !lower.contains("\\windowsapps\\") && !lower.contains("\\xboxgames\\") {
            continue;
        }
        let game_name = reg_string(&sub, "DisplayName");
        let name = if game_name.is_empty() { sub_name } else { game_name };
        if let Some(game) = make_game(&name, "Xbox", &location, "") {
            list.push(game);
        }
    }
}

fn load_xbox(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>) {
    load_xbox_uninstall(list, true);
    load_xbox_uninstall(list, false);
    for letter in b'C'..=b'Z' {
        let root = format!("{}:\\XboxGames", letter as char);
        if Path::new(&root).is_dir() {
            load_sub_folders(list, Path::new(&root), "Xbox");
        }
    }
}

fn load_ea(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>) {
    load_registry_roots(list, true, "SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\EA Games", "EA", "Install Dir", "DisplayName");
    load_registry_roots(list, false, "SOFTWARE\\EA Games", "EA", "Install Dir", "DisplayName");
}

fn load_ubisoft(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>) {
    load_registry_roots(
        list,
        true,
        "SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Ubisoft\\Launcher\\Installs",
        "Ubisoft",
        "InstallDir",
        "",
    );
    load_registry_roots(
        list,
        false,
        "SOFTWARE\\Ubisoft\\Launcher\\Installs",
        "Ubisoft",
        "InstallDir",
        "",
    );
}

fn load_battlenet(list: &mut Vec<GameInfo>) {
    load_registry_roots(
        list,
        true,
        "SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Blizzard Entertainment",
        "Battle.net",
        "InstallPath",
        "",
    );
    load_registry_roots(
        list,
        false,
        "SOFTWARE\\Blizzard Entertainment",
        "Battle.net",
        "InstallPath",
        "",
    );
}

pub struct GameLibrary;

impl GameLibrary {
    pub fn load_all() -> Vec<GameInfo> {
        let mut list: Vec<GameInfo> = Vec::new();
        load_steam(&mut list);
        load_epic(&mut list);
        load_gog(&mut list);
        load_windows_games(&mut list);
        load_ea(&mut list);
        load_ubisoft(&mut list);
        load_battlenet(&mut list);
        load_xbox(&mut list);
        list.extend(SavedGames::load());

        let mut seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
        let mut result = Vec::new();
        for game in list {
            if game.root.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            if seen.insert(game.root.to_lowercase()) {
                result.push(game);
            }
        }
        result
    }

    pub fn match_path(exe_path: &str) -> Option<GameInfo> {
        if exe_path.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let list = Self::load_all();
        for game in &list {
            if !game.exe_path.is_empty() && game.exe_path.eq_ignore_ascii_case(exe_path) {
                return Some(game.clone());
            }
        }
        let mut best: Option<&GameInfo> = None;
        for game in &list {
            if game.root.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(current) = best {
                if game.root.len() <= current.root.len() {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if crate::util::is_under(exe_path, &game.root) {
                best = Some(game);
            }
        }
        best.cloned()
    }
}

pub struct SavedGames;

impl SavedGames {
    pub fn file_path() -> PathBuf {
        let base = std::env::var("LOCALAPPDATA").unwrap_or_default();
        Path::new(&base).join("GameApiDetector").join("games.tsv")
    }

    pub fn load() -> Vec<GameInfo> {
        let mut list = Vec::new();
        let file = Self::file_path();
        let text = match fs::read_to_string(&file) {
            Ok(t) => t,
            Err(_) => return list,
        };
        let mut seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
        for line in text.lines() {
            if line.trim().is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split('\t').collect();
            if parts.len() < 3 {
                continue;
            }
            let platform = parts[0].trim().to_string();
            let name = parts[1].trim().to_string();
            let exe = parts[2].trim().to_string();
            if exe.is_empty() || !seen.insert(exe.to_lowercase()) {
                continue;
            }
            if !Path::new(&exe).is_file() {
                continue;
            }
            let stem = Path::new(&exe)
                .file_stem()
                .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            list.push(GameInfo {
                name: if name.is_empty() { stem } else { name },
                platform: if platform.is_empty() { "本地".to_string() } else { platform },
                root: dir_of(&exe),
                exe_path: exe,
            });
        }
        list
    }

    pub fn add(exe_path: &str, name: &str, platform: &str) -> bool {
        let exe = exe_path.trim().to_string();
        if exe.is_empty() || !Path::new(&exe).is_file() {
            return false;
        }
        let mut list = Self::load();
        let mut changed = false;
        let mut found = false;
        for game in list.iter_mut() {
            if !game.exe_path.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&exe) {
                continue;
            }
            found = true;
            if !name.is_empty() && game.name != name {
                game.name = name.to_string();
                changed = true;
            }
            if !platform.is_empty() && game.platform != platform {
                game.platform = platform.to_string();
                changed = true;
            }
            break;
        }
        if !found {
            let stem = Path::new(&exe)
                .file_stem()
                .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            list.push(GameInfo {
                name: if name.is_empty() { stem } else { name.to_string() },
                platform: if platform.is_empty() { "本地".to_string() } else { platform.to_string() },
                root: dir_of(&exe),
                exe_path: exe,
            });
            changed = true;
        }
        if changed {
            Self::write_all(&list);
        }
        changed
    }

    pub fn remove(exe_path: &str) -> bool {
        let mut list = Self::load();
        let before = list.len();
        list.retain(|g| !g.exe_path.eq_ignore_ascii_case(exe_path));
        if list.len() == before {
            return false;
        }
        Self::write_all(&list);
        true
    }

    fn write_all(list: &[GameInfo]) {
        let file = Self::file_path();
        if let Some(dir) = file.parent() {
            let _ = fs::create_dir_all(dir);
        }
        let mut out = String::new();
        for game in list {
            out.push_str(&game.platform.replace('\t', " "));
            out.push('\t');
            out.push_str(&game.name.replace('\t', " "));
            out.push('\t');
            out.push_str(&game.exe_path);
            out.push_str("\r\n");
        }
        let _ = fs::write(&file, out);
    }
}

pub struct GameExe;

impl GameExe {
    const NOISE: [&'static str; 16] = [
        "unins", "uninstall", "setup", "install", "vcredist", "dxsetup", "directx", "dotnet",
        "crash", "report", "updater", "update", "helper", "activation", "eula", "touchup",
    ];

    const SKIP_DIRS: [&'static str; 6] = ["_commonredist", "redist", "directx", "support", "docs", "tools"];

    pub fn locate(game: &GameInfo) -> String {
        if !game.exe_path.is_empty() && Path::new(&game.exe_path).is_file() {
            return game.exe_path.clone();
        }
        if game.root.is_empty() || !Path::new(&game.root).is_dir() {
            return String::new();
        }
        Self::search(Path::new(&game.root), &normalize(&game.name), 0)
    }

    fn search(dir: &Path, target: &str, depth: usize) -> String {
        let mut best = String::new();
        let mut best_size: u64 = 0;
        let folder = normalize(
            &dir.file_name()
                .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
                .unwrap_or_default(),
        );

        if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(dir) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                if !path.is_file() {
                    continue;
                }
                if path.extension().map(|e| e.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase()) != Some("exe".to_string()) {
                    continue;
                }
                let stem = normalize(
                    &path
                        .file_stem()
                        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
                        .unwrap_or_default(),
                );
                if Self::is_noise(&stem) {
                    continue;
                }
                if !target.is_empty() && stem == target {
                    return path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
                }
                if !folder.is_empty() && stem == folder {
                    return path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
                }
                let size = entry.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);
                if size > best_size || best.is_empty() {
                    best_size = size;
                    best = path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
                }
            }
        }
        if !best.is_empty() {
            return best;
        }
        if depth >= 2 {
            return String::new();
        }
        if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(dir) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                if !path.is_dir() {
                    continue;
                }
                let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();
                if Self::SKIP_DIRS.contains(&name.as_str()) {
                    continue;
                }
                let found = Self::search(&path, target, depth + 1);
                if !found.is_empty() {
                    return found;
                }
            }
        }
        String::new()
    }

    fn is_noise(stem: &str) -> bool {
        Self::NOISE.iter().any(|n| stem.contains(n))
    }
}

fn normalize(value: &str) -> String {
    value
        .chars()
        .filter(|c| c.is_alphanumeric())
        .flat_map(|c| c.to_lowercase())
        .collect()
}

```

`src/main.rs`:

```rs
#![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")]

mod app;
mod dxvk;
mod library;
mod process;
mod util;

fn main() -> eframe::Result<()> {
    let mut viewport = eframe::egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
        .with_title("游戏图形 API 检测器")
        .with_inner_size([1180.0, 720.0])
        .with_min_inner_size([960.0, 560.0]);
    if let Some(icon) = util::window_icon() {
        viewport = viewport.with_icon(icon);
    }

    let options = eframe::NativeOptions {
        viewport,
        ..Default::default()
    };

    eframe::run_native(
        "游戏图形 API 检测器",
        options,
        Box::new(|cc| {
            util::install_fonts(&cc.egui_ctx);
            Ok(Box::new(app::App::new(cc)) as Box<dyn eframe::App>)
        }),
    )
}

```

`src/process.rs`:

```rs
use std::path::Path;
use std::process::Command;

use windows::core::{BOOL, PWSTR};
use windows::Win32::Foundation::{CloseHandle, HMODULE, HWND, LPARAM};
use windows::Win32::System::ProcessStatus::{
    EnumProcesses, EnumProcessModulesEx, GetModuleBaseNameW, GetModuleFileNameExW, LIST_MODULES_ALL,
};
use windows::Win32::System::Threading::{
    IsWow64Process, OpenProcess, QueryFullProcessImageNameW, TerminateProcess,
    PROCESS_NAME_WIN32, PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION,
    PROCESS_VM_READ,
};
use windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{EnumWindows, GetWindowTextW, GetWindowThreadProcessId};

pub const API_NONE: &str = "未检测到";
pub const API_UNREADABLE: &str = "无法读取";
pub const API_NOT_RUNNING: &str = "未运行";
pub const API_NO_EXE: &str = "缺少可执行文件";

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Row {
    pub pid: i32,
    pub run_pid: u32,
    pub name: String,
    pub title: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub arch: String,
    pub api: String,
    pub key_modules: String,
    pub gfx_modules: Vec<String>,
    pub module_count: usize,
    pub error: String,
    pub has_window: bool,
    pub game_name: String,
    pub platform: String,
    pub is_game: bool,
    pub game_known: bool,
    pub dxvk: String,
}

impl Row {
    pub fn has_graphics(&self) -> bool {
        !self.api.is_empty() && self.api != API_NONE && self.api != API_UNREADABLE
    }

    pub fn running(&self) -> bool {
        self.run_pid > 0
    }

    pub fn game_text(&self) -> String {
        if !self.is_game {
            return String::new();
        }
        if self.game_known {
            if self.game_name.is_empty() {
                self.name.clone()
            } else {
                self.game_name.clone()
            }
        } else {
            format!("未知游戏 ({})", self.name)
        }
    }

    pub fn platform_text(&self) -> String {
        if !self.is_game {
            return String::new();
        }
        if self.platform.is_empty() {
            "未知".to_string()
        } else {
            self.platform.clone()
        }
    }

    pub fn install_dir(&self) -> String {
        match Path::new(&self.path).parent() {
            Some(p) => p.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
            None => String::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn reset_live(&mut self) {
        self.run_pid = 0;
        self.api = API_NOT_RUNNING.to_string();
        self.arch = "—".to_string();
        self.title.clear();
        self.key_modules.clear();
        self.gfx_modules.clear();
        self.module_count = 0;
        self.has_window = false;
        self.error.clear();
    }

    pub fn merge_live(&mut self, live: &Row) {
        self.api = live.api.clone();
        self.arch = live.arch.clone();
        self.title = live.title.clone();
        self.key_modules = live.key_modules.clone();
        self.gfx_modules = live.gfx_modules.clone();
        self.module_count = live.module_count;
        self.has_window = live.has_window;
        self.error = live.error.clone();
        if !live.dxvk.is_empty() {
            self.dxvk = live.dxvk.clone();
        }
        if !live.path.is_empty() {
            self.path = live.path.clone();
        }
    }
}

const GFX_MODULES: [&str; 19] = [
    "vulkan-1.dll",
    "d3d12.dll",
    "d3d12core.dll",
    "d3d11.dll",
    "d3d11on12.dll",
    "d3d10.dll",
    "d3d10_1.dll",
    "d3d9.dll",
    "d3d9on12.dll",
    "opengl32.dll",
    "nvoglv64.dll",
    "nvoglv32.dll",
    "atioglxx.dll",
    "atio6axx.dll",
    "ig7icd64.dll",
    "ig7icd32.dll",
    "ig9icd64.dll",
    "ig9icd32.dll",
    "ig10icd64.dll",
];

fn is_gfx_module(name: &str) -> bool {
    GFX_MODULES.iter().any(|m| m.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))
}

pub fn enumerate_processes() -> Vec<(u32, String)> {
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    let mut capacity = 4096usize;
    loop {
        let mut pids = vec![0u32; capacity];
        let mut needed: u32 = 0;
        let bytes = (pids.len() * std::mem::size_of::<u32>()) as u32;
        if unsafe { EnumProcesses(pids.as_mut_ptr(), bytes, &mut needed) }.is_err() {
            return result;
        }
        let count = needed as usize / std::mem::size_of::<u32>();
        if count >= capacity {
            capacity *= 2;
            continue;
        }
        pids.truncate(count);
        for pid in pids {
            if pid == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(name) = process_name(pid) {
                result.push((pid, name));
            }
        }
        break;
    }
    result
}

pub fn process_name(pid: u32) -> Option<String> {
    unsafe {
        let handle = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, false, pid).ok()?;
        let mut buf = [0u16; 512];
        let len = GetModuleBaseNameW(handle, None, &mut buf);
        let _ = CloseHandle(handle);
        if len == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        Some(String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..len as usize]))
    }
}

pub fn read_path(pid: u32) -> String {
    unsafe {
        let handle = match OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, false, pid) {
            Ok(h) => h,
            Err(_) => return String::new(),
        };
        let mut buf = [0u16; 1024];
        let mut size = buf.len() as u32;
        let ok = QueryFullProcessImageNameW(
            handle,
            PROCESS_NAME_WIN32,
            PWSTR(buf.as_mut_ptr()),
            &mut size,
        )
        .is_ok();
        let _ = CloseHandle(handle);
        if !ok || size == 0 {
            return String::new();
        }
        String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..size as usize])
    }
}

pub fn bitness(pid: u32) -> String {
    unsafe {
        let handle = match OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, false, pid) {
            Ok(h) => h,
            Err(_) => return "未知".to_string(),
        };
        let mut wow64 = BOOL(0);
        let ok = IsWow64Process(handle, &mut wow64).is_ok();
        let _ = CloseHandle(handle);
        if !ok {
            return "未知".to_string();
        }
        if wow64.as_bool() {
            "32 位".to_string()
        } else {
            "64 位".to_string()
        }
    }
}

struct TitleSearch {
    pid: u32,
    title: Option<String>,
}

unsafe extern "system" fn enum_windows_callback(hwnd: HWND, lparam: LPARAM) -> BOOL {
    let ctx = &mut *(lparam.0 as *mut TitleSearch);
    let mut window_pid: u32 = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, Some(&mut window_pid));
    if window_pid != ctx.pid {
        return BOOL(1);
    }
    let mut buf = [0u16; 512];
    let len = GetWindowTextW(hwnd, &mut buf);
    if len > 0 {
        ctx.title = Some(String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..len as usize]));
        return BOOL(0);
    }
    BOOL(1)
}

pub fn window_title(pid: u32) -> String {
    let mut ctx = TitleSearch {
        pid,
        title: None,
    };
    unsafe {
        let _ = EnumWindows(
            Some(enum_windows_callback),
            LPARAM(&mut ctx as *mut TitleSearch as isize),
        );
    }
    ctx.title.unwrap_or_default()
}

pub fn module_names(pid: u32) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
    unsafe {
        let handle = OpenProcess(
            PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ,
            false,
            pid,
        )
        .map_err(|_| "无法打开进程（请尝试以管理员身份运行，或进程已退出）".to_string())?;

        let mut needed: u32 = 0;
        let _ = EnumProcessModulesEx(handle, std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, &mut needed, LIST_MODULES_ALL);
        if needed == 0 {
            let _ = CloseHandle(handle);
            return Err("无法枚举进程模块".to_string());
        }

        let count = needed as usize / std::mem::size_of::<isize>();
        let mut modules = vec![HMODULE::default(); count];
        let bytes = needed;
        if EnumProcessModulesEx(
            handle,
            modules.as_mut_ptr(),
            bytes,
            &mut needed,
            LIST_MODULES_ALL,
        )
        .is_err()
        {
            let _ = CloseHandle(handle);
            return Err("无法枚举进程模块（权限不足）".to_string());
        }

        let mut names = Vec::new();
        let mut buf = [0u16; 1024];
        for module in modules {
            let len = GetModuleFileNameExW(Some(handle), Some(module), &mut buf);
            if len > 0 {
                let full = String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..len as usize]);
                if let Some(name) = Path::new(&full).file_name() {
                    names.push(name.to_string_lossy().to_string());
                }
            }
        }
        let _ = CloseHandle(handle);
        Ok(names)
    }
}

pub fn detect_api(modules: &[String]) -> (String, String) {
    let has = |name: &str| modules.iter().any(|m| m.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name));
    let mut apis: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
    if has("vulkan-1.dll") {
        apis.push("Vulkan");
    }
    if has("d3d12.dll") || has("d3d12core.dll") {
        apis.push("DirectX 12");
    }
    if has("d3d11.dll") || has("d3d11on12.dll") {
        apis.push("DirectX 11");
    }
    if has("opengl32.dll") {
        apis.push("OpenGL");
    }
    if has("d3d10.dll") || has("d3d10_1.dll") {
        apis.push("DirectX 10");
    }
    if has("d3d9.dll") || has("d3d9on12.dll") {
        apis.push("DirectX 9");
    }

    let key_modules = modules.join(", ");
    if apis.is_empty() {
        return (API_NONE.to_string(), key_modules);
    }
    let api = if apis.len() > 1 {
        format!("{}（另见 {}）", apis[0], apis[1..].join(" / "))
    } else {
        apis[0].to_string()
    };
    (api, key_modules)
}

pub fn inspect(pid: u32) -> Row {
    let mut row = Row::default();
    row.pid = pid as i32;
    row.run_pid = pid;
    row.name = process_name(pid).unwrap_or_else(|| "?".to_string());
    row.path = read_path(pid);
    row.arch = bitness(pid);
    row.title = window_title(pid);
    row.has_window = !row.title.is_empty();

    match module_names(pid) {
        Ok(mods) => {
            row.module_count = mods.len();
            let mut gfx: Vec<String> = mods
                .iter()
                .filter(|m| is_gfx_module(m))
                .cloned()
                .collect();
            gfx.sort_by(|a, b| a.to_lowercase().cmp(&b.to_lowercase()));
            gfx.dedup_by(|a, b| a.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b));
            row.gfx_modules = gfx;
            let (api, key) = detect_api(&row.gfx_modules);
            row.api = api;
            row.key_modules = key;
        }
        Err(err) => {
            row.error = err;
            row.api = API_UNREADABLE.to_string();
        }
    }
    row
}

pub fn find_running_pid(exe_path: &str, exe_name: &str) -> u32 {
    if exe_name.is_empty() {
        return 0;
    }
    for (pid, name) in enumerate_processes() {
        if !name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(exe_name) {
            continue;
        }
        let path = read_path(pid);
        if !exe_path.is_empty() && !path.is_empty() && !path.eq_ignore_ascii_case(exe_path) {
            continue;
        }
        return pid;
    }
    0
}

pub fn is_running(exe_name: &str) -> bool {
    if exe_name.is_empty() {
        return false;
    }
    enumerate_processes()
        .iter()
        .any(|(_, name)| name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(exe_name))
}

pub fn kill(pid: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
    unsafe {
        let handle = OpenProcess(
            PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | windows::Win32::System::Threading::PROCESS_TERMINATE,
            false,
            pid,
        )
        .map_err(|e| e.message().to_string())?;
        let result = TerminateProcess(handle, 1);
        let _ = CloseHandle(handle);
        if result.is_err() {
            return Err("无法结束进程".to_string());
        }
        for _ in 0..30 {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));
            if !is_pid_alive(pid) {
                break;
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn is_pid_alive(pid: u32) -> bool {
    unsafe {
        match OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, false, pid) {
            Ok(h) => {
                let _ = CloseHandle(h);
                true
            }
            Err(_) => false,
        }
    }
}

pub fn start(exe: &str, args: &str, working_dir: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut command = Command::new(exe);
    for arg in split_args(args) {
        command.arg(arg);
    }
    if !working_dir.is_empty() {
        command.current_dir(working_dir);
    } else if let Some(parent) = Path::new(exe).parent() {
        command.current_dir(parent);
    }
    command
        .spawn()
        .map(|_| ())
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

fn split_args(text: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    text.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect()
}

pub fn start_elevated(exe: &str, args: &str, working_dir: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut cmd = format!("\"{}\"", exe);
    if !args.is_empty() {
        cmd.push(' ');
        cmd.push_str(args);
    }
    let mut command = Command::new("cmd");
    command.args(["/C", "start", "", &cmd]);
    if !working_dir.is_empty() {
        command.current_dir(working_dir);
    }
    command.spawn().map(|_| ()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

pub fn shell_open_folder(path: &str) {
    let path = path.trim();
    if path.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let _ = Command::new("explorer").arg(path).spawn();
}
```

`src/util.rs`:

```rs
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;

use eframe::egui;
use windows::core::PCWSTR;
use windows::Win32::Storage::FileSystem::{
    GetFileVersionInfoSizeW, GetFileVersionInfoW, VerQueryValueW,
};

pub fn wide(text: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
    let mut v: Vec<u16> = text.encode_utf16().collect();
    v.push(0);
    v
}

pub fn is_under(path: &str, dir: &str) -> bool {
    if path.is_empty() || dir.is_empty() {
        return false;
    }
    let mut prefix = dir.to_string();
    if !prefix.ends_with('\\') {
        prefix.push('\\');
    }
    path.len() >= prefix.len() && path[..prefix.len()].eq_ignore_ascii_case(&prefix)
}

pub fn file_version_strings(exe: &str) -> Option<(String, String, String)> {
    if exe.is_empty() || !Path::new(exe).is_file() {
        return None;
    }
    unsafe {
        let path = wide(exe);
        let pcw = PCWSTR(path.as_ptr());
        let size = GetFileVersionInfoSizeW(pcw, None);
        if size == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        let mut buf = vec![0u8; size as usize];
        if GetFileVersionInfoW(pcw, None, size, buf.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void).is_err() {
            return None;
        }

        let mut ptr: *mut c_void = std::ptr::null_mut();
        let mut len: u32 = 0;
        let translation_key = wide("\\VarFileInfo\\Translation");
        if !VerQueryValueW(
            buf.as_ptr() as *const c_void,
            PCWSTR(translation_key.as_ptr()),
            &mut ptr,
            &mut len,
        )
        .as_bool()
        {
            return None;
        }
        if ptr.is_null() || len < 4 {
            return None;
        }
        let lang = *(ptr as *const u16);
        let codepage = *((ptr as *const u16).add(1));

        let read_field = |name: &str| -> String {
            let key = wide(&format!(
                "\\StringFileInfo\\{:04x}{:04x}\\{}",
                lang, codepage, name
            ));
            let mut field_ptr: *mut c_void = std::ptr::null_mut();
            let mut field_len: u32 = 0;
            if !VerQueryValueW(
                buf.as_ptr() as *const c_void,
                PCWSTR(key.as_ptr()),
                &mut field_ptr,
                &mut field_len,
            )
            .as_bool()
            {
                return String::new();
            }
            if field_ptr.is_null() || field_len == 0 {
                return String::new();
            }
            let slice = std::slice::from_raw_parts(field_ptr as *const u16, field_len as usize);
            let end = slice.iter().position(|&c| c == 0).unwrap_or(slice.len());
            String::from_utf16_lossy(&slice[..end])
        };

        Some((
            read_field("FileDescription"),
            read_field("CompanyName"),
            read_field("ProductName"),
        ))
    }
}

fn decode_png(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<egui::IconData> {
    let decoder = png::Decoder::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes));
    let mut reader = decoder.read_info().ok()?;
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; reader.output_buffer_size().unwrap_or(0)];
    let info = reader.next_frame(&mut buf).ok()?;
    let width = info.width;
    let height = info.height;
    let data = &buf[..info.buffer_size()];
    let rgba = match info.color_type {
        png::ColorType::Rgba => data.to_vec(),
        png::ColorType::Rgb => data
            .chunks_exact(3)
            .flat_map(|p| [p[0], p[1], p[2], 255])
            .collect(),
        png::ColorType::GrayscaleAlpha => data
            .chunks_exact(2)
            .flat_map(|p| [p[0], p[0], p[0], p[1]])
            .collect(),
        png::ColorType::Grayscale => data.iter().flat_map(|&g| [g, g, g, 255]).collect(),
        _ => return None,
    };
    Some(egui::IconData {
        rgba,
        width,
        height,
    })
}

fn largest_ico_png(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<&[u8]> {
    if bytes.len() < 6 || bytes[0] != 0 || bytes[1] != 0 || bytes[2] != 1 || bytes[3] != 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let count = u16::from_le_bytes([bytes[4], bytes[5]]) as usize;
    let mut best: Option<(u32, usize, usize)> = None;
    for i in 0..count {
        let base = 6 + i * 16;
        if base + 16 > bytes.len() {
            break;
        }
        let size = u32::from_le_bytes([
            bytes[base + 8],
            bytes[base + 9],
            bytes[base + 10],
            bytes[base + 11],
        ]);
        let offset = u32::from_le_bytes([
            bytes[base + 12],
            bytes[base + 13],
            bytes[base + 14],
            bytes[base + 15],
        ]) as usize;
        if offset + 8 > bytes.len() {
            continue;
        }
        let is_png = bytes[offset] == 0x89
            && bytes[offset + 1] == b'P'
            && bytes[offset + 2] == b'N'
            && bytes[offset + 3] == b'G';
        if !is_png {
            continue;
        }
        if best.map(|(s, _, _)| size > s).unwrap_or(true) {
            best = Some((size, offset, size as usize));
        }
    }
    best.map(|(_, offset, size)| &bytes[offset..offset + size])
}

pub fn window_icon() -> Option<egui::IconData> {
    let bytes = include_bytes!("../app.ico");
    let png = largest_ico_png(bytes)?;
    decode_png(png)
}

pub fn install_fonts(ctx: &egui::Context) {
    const CANDIDATES: [&str; 6] = [
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyh.ttc",
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyh.ttf",
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\simhei.ttf",
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\Deng.ttf",
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\simsun.ttc",
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyhbd.ttc",
    ];
    for path in CANDIDATES {
        if let Ok(bytes) = fs::read(path) {
            let mut fonts = egui::FontDefinitions::default();
            fonts
                .font_data
                .insert("cjk".to_owned(), egui::FontData::from_owned(bytes).into());
            if let Some(list) = fonts.families.get_mut(&egui::FontFamily::Proportional) {
                list.insert(0, "cjk".to_owned());
            }
            if let Some(list) = fonts.families.get_mut(&egui::FontFamily::Monospace) {
                list.push("cjk".to_owned());
            }
            ctx.set_fonts(fonts);
            return;
        }
    }
}
```
